title: Median output of randomized selection
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type and let $l$ be a nonempty finite list in $\alpha$. Every outcome $(a,c)$ in the support of the randomized selection procedure on input $(\lfloor(|l|+1)/2\rfloor,l)$ has $a=y$ for some $y\in\alpha$ such that at least half the entries of $l$, counting multiplicity, are less than or equal to $y$, and at least half are greater than or equal to $y$.
hypotheses_covered: The outcome lies in the support of the procedure
